title: ISC BIND: attackers can knock it offline
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The exploit prediction score is 100%.

category.label: Servers and backups
category.why: It runs or protects many systems at once, including your backups.
category.doThis: Patch it and keep its admin access off the internet.

summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 11, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
